_note: Week of July 13–19, 2026. Southwest / Tex-Mex theme, warm-weather leaning with several cold or no-cook nights. Monday's steak is bought in a larger batch so Tuesday's street tacos can run on the leftover portion plus a shrimp treat protein. Wednesday and Friday keep two fish nights (cod, salmon). Thursday is a fully cold shrimp and black bean salad. Saturday is a cold vegetarian quinoa and black bean salad. Sunday is standing breakfast-for-dinner — Southwest migas, not waffles (Birch Benders stay Sunday morning only). No raw onion, no mushrooms, no lentils, no okra/eggplant anywhere. Reheated chicken stays out of Laine's lunch; Jake's lunch batch uses chicken. Four new ingredients added to nutrition.json this week: Corn kernels (frozen), Cilantro, Lime juice, Cotija cheese.

tzatziki.name: Cilantro-Lime Crema
tzatziki.note: This week's standalone sauce card, replacing the usual tzatziki/raita slot. A quick sour-cream crema with lime and garlic — used as the taco sauce Tuesday and as a bowl drizzle Monday. Makes about 1.25 cups (roughly 8 servings), keeps 4–5 days.
steps: Whisk the sour cream, lime juice, and minced garlic together until smooth.
Stir in the chopped cilantro. Season with a pinch of salt.
Chill at least 15 min before serving. Thin with a splash of water or extra lime juice if you want it pourable. Keeps 4–5 days covered.

dinners.name: Chili-Lime Steak Bowls
dinners.note: Seared steak strips over rice with black beans, corn, bell pepper, and avocado, finished with cotija and a lime-cilantro drizzle. Buy extra steak tonight so Tuesday's tacos can run on the leftover portion.

ingredients.item: Flank/sirloin steak — Jake 210g, Laine 120g raw, sliced into strips (buy extra for Tuesday)
Black beans — Jake ~0.2 can, Laine ~0.15 can, rinsed
Corn kernels (frozen) — Jake 0.3 cup, Laine 0.22 cup, thawed
Avocado — Jake ½, Laine ⅖, sliced
Cotija cheese, crumbled — Jake 1.5 tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine 0.75 tbsp
Cilantro, chopped — Jake ¼ cup, Laine ⅕ cup
Cilantro-lime crema — 2–3 tbsp per person (see recipe card)

steps: Cook rice: simmer in salted water 15–18 min, fluff, keep warm.
Slice steak into thin strips, season with cumin, paprika, garlic powder, and salt. Sear in a hot pan 3–4 min per side to medium, rest 5 min, then slice thinner against the grain.
Warm black beans and corn together in a small pan with a squeeze of lime.
Build bowls: rice, steak, beans and corn, bell pepper, avocado. Top with cotija, cilantro, and a drizzle of the crema.

dinners.name: Steak & Shrimp Street Tacos
dinners.note: Standing leftovers-plus-a-treat night. Monday's leftover steak carries the tacos; shrimp is the treat protein. Corn tortillas, shredded romaine, cotija, and the cilantro-lime crema round it out.

ingredients.item: Leftover flank/sirloin steak — Jake 90g, Laine 65g, sliced/chopped
Cotija cheese, crumbled — Jake 1.5 tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Cilantro-lime crema — Jake 3 tbsp, Laine 2 tbsp
Lime juice — ~1 tbsp shared, for the shrimp and to finish

steps: Warm the leftover steak in a dry skillet just until heated through.
Pat shrimp dry, season with cumin, paprika, garlic powder, and salt. Sear 1–2 min per side until just pink.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or over a low flame, 20–30 sec per side.
Fill tortillas with steak and shrimp, top with romaine, cotija, and a spoon of crema. Finish with a squeeze of lime. Jake gets the extra tortilla and more of both proteins.

dinners.name: Baked Cod with Southwest Corn & Black Bean Salsa
dinners.note: More-fish night. Cod roasted simply, served over rice with a warm corn, black bean, and tomato salsa spooned over the top, plus avocado and a squeeze of lime.

ingredients.item: Corn kernels (frozen) — Jake 0.3 cup, Laine 0.22 cup, thawed
Black beans — Jake ~0.18 can, Laine ~0.13 can, rinsed
Diced tomatoes (canned) — Jake 0.3 cup, Laine 0.25 cup
Avocado — Jake ⅗, Laine ½, sliced
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine 0.75 tbsp
Cilantro, chopped — Jake ⅕ cup, Laine 0.15 cup

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Pat cod dry, season with cumin, paprika, garlic powder, and salt. Bake 14–16 min until it flakes.
Cook rice: simmer in salted water 15–18 min, fluff.
Warm the corn, black beans, and diced tomatoes together in a small pan with a squeeze of lime — this is the salsa.
Plate cod over rice, spoon the salsa over the top, and add avocado and cilantro. Jake gets the bigger fillet.

dinners.name: Cold Shrimp & Black Bean Southwest Salad
dinners.note: Fully cold, no stove needed at serving time. Shrimp, black beans, corn, bell pepper, and avocado over romaine, dressed in lime and olive oil with cotija on top.

ingredients.item: Frozen shrimp — Jake 210g, Laine 150g raw, cooked and chilled
Black beans — Jake ~0.22 can, Laine ~0.16 can, rinsed
Corn kernels (frozen) — Jake 0.3 cup, Laine 0.22 cup, thawed
Avocado — Jake ⅖, Laine ⅓, diced
Cotija cheese, crumbled — Jake 2 tbsp, Laine 1.5 tbsp
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine 0.75 tbsp
Cilantro, chopped — Jake ⅕ cup, Laine 0.15 cup

steps: Bring shrimp to a quick boil or sear if not already cooked, then chill in the fridge for at least 20 min.
Combine romaine, black beans, corn, bell pepper, and avocado in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lime juice, cumin, and salt; toss through the salad.
Top with chilled shrimp, cotija, and cilantro. Serve cold — no reheating tonight.

dinners.name: Chili-Lime Salmon with Sweet Potato & Black Beans
dinners.note: Second fish night. Roasted salmon with a chili-lime rub alongside mashed sweet potato and warm black beans.

ingredients.item: Black beans — Jake ~0.18 can, Laine ~0.13 can, rinsed
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine 0.75 tbsp
Cilantro, chopped — Jake ⅕ cup, Laine 0.1 cup

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Pat salmon dry, rub with olive oil, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and a squeeze of lime. Roast skin-side down 12–14 min until just opaque.
Boil or steam the sweet potato cubes 12–15 min until fork-tender, then mash with a splash of water and a pinch of salt.
Warm the black beans in a small pan.
Plate salmon with the mashed sweet potato and beans alongside. Finish with cilantro and a final squeeze of lime. Jake gets the bigger fillet.

dinners.name: Southwest Black Bean & Quinoa Salad with Avocado and Cotija
dinners.note: Vegetarian, cold-friendly night. Quinoa, black beans, corn, bell pepper, and avocado with lime and cotija, warm tortilla on the side for Jake.

ingredients.item: Black beans — Jake ~0.28 can, Laine ~0.2 can, rinsed
Corn kernels (frozen) — Jake 0.3 cup, Laine 0.22 cup, thawed
Avocado — Jake ½, Laine ⅖, diced
Cotija cheese, crumbled — Jake 2 tbsp, Laine 1.5 tbsp
Olive oil — Jake 1.2 tbsp, Laine 0.9 tbsp
Cilantro, chopped — Jake ¼ cup, Laine ⅕ cup

steps: Cook quinoa: rinse, simmer in 2× water 15 min, rest 5 min, fluff, then cool slightly.
Combine quinoa, black beans, corn, bell pepper, and avocado in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lime juice, cumin, and salt; toss through the salad.
Top with cotija and cilantro. Warm Jake's tortilla on the side. Serve cold or room temp.

dinners.name: Southwest Migas — Scrambled Eggs with Tortillas, Black Beans & Avocado
dinners.note: Standing breakfast-for-dinner — doesn't have to be waffles, and isn't this week. Soft scrambled eggs with crisped tortilla strips, black beans, bell pepper, and avocado, finished with cotija.

ingredients.item: Liquid egg whites — Jake ⅛ cup, Laine ⅛ cup
Corn tortillas (small) — Jake 1.25, Laine 1, torn into strips
Black beans — Jake ~0.15 can, Laine ~0.1 can, rinsed
Avocado — Jake ⅗, Laine ½, sliced
Cotija cheese, crumbled — Jake 1.5 tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine 0.75 tbsp
Cilantro, chopped — Jake ⅕ cup, Laine 0.1 cup

steps: Warm olive oil in a nonstick pan. Add torn tortilla strips, crisp 2–3 min, then push to the side.
Add bell pepper and black beans to the pan, warm through 1–2 min.
Beat eggs and egg whites together, pour in, scramble gently over medium-low until just set, folding in the tortilla and beans.
Top with avocado, cotija, and cilantro.

jakeLunch.name: Southwest Chicken & Black Bean Batch Bowl
jakeLunch.note: Southwest batch bowl, same 5-container Sunday format, no fish (office-friendly). Lime-cumin chicken, quinoa, black beans, corn, and bell pepper, cotija added fresh. No dressing batched in — add a squeeze of lime when eating.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast — ~3.2 lbs total (230g raw per container)
Corn kernels (frozen) — 0.3 cup per container, thawed
Cotija cheese, crumbled — 1.5 tbsp per container

steps: Marinate chicken in olive oil, lime juice, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, and salt — 20–30 min if you have time.
Cook all the quinoa at once: rinse, simmer in 2× water 15 min, rest 5 min, fluff.
Grill or pan-sear the chicken in batches, ~6–7 min per side until 165°F. Rest, then slice or dice.
Divide into 5 containers: quinoa, chicken, black beans, corn, bell pepper. Top with cotija and cilantro fresh, plus a squeeze of lime when reheating/eating.

laineLunch.name: Cold Southwest Tuna & Black Bean Jar — Mason Jar Style
laineLunch.note: Southwest cold jar. Tuna, black beans, corn, bell pepper, cotija, and romaine, eaten cold over two sittings. Avocado added fresh at the second sitting so it doesn't brown. No chicken, no lentils.
laineLunch.dressingNote: Lime-olive oil vinaigrette: 1 tbsp olive oil + ½ tbsp lime juice + pinch cumin + salt, drizzled in just before eating rather than batched.

ingredients.item: Canned tuna in water — 1.25 cans total, split across 5 jars
Black beans — ~0.15 can per jar, rinsed
Corn kernels (frozen) — ~0.3 cup per jar, thawed
Avocado — ~0.3 per jar, added fresh before eating
Cotija cheese, crumbled — ~1 tbsp per jar
Olive oil — ~1 tbsp per jar (dressing, separate)

steps: Drain tuna well, rinse black beans, dice bell pepper.
Layer each jar: black beans → tuna → corn → bell pepper → cotija → romaine on top.
Mix the lime-olive oil dressing; portion into a small separate container per jar.
To eat: pour in dressing, shake, add fresh avocado, eat half — reseal for the second sitting.

laineBreakfasts.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl. Top with thawed berries and flaxseed.

laineBreakfasts.name: Southwest Egg White Scramble
laineBreakfasts.note: Bell pepper and a pinch of cumin — mild, light, no heat.
steps: Sauté bell pepper 1–2 min in a dry nonstick pan until it starts to soften.
Add egg whites, scramble over medium-low until just set.
Top with cotija and a pinch of cumin.

laineBreakfasts.name: Birch Benders Waffles + Berries
laineBreakfasts.note: Standing Sunday-morning waffles — separate from Sunday's breakfast-for-dinner.

ingredients.item: Birch Benders pancake/waffle mix — ½ cup dry

steps: Mix batter: mix + egg whites + water per package. Stir in flaxseed.
Cook in a preheated waffle iron 3–4 min until crisp.
Top with thawed berries.

laineSnacks.name: Banana + Greek Yogurt
laineSnacks.desc: 1 banana + 1 Oikos Triple Zero. Potassium + calcium snack.

laineSnacks.name: Roasted Chickpeas
laineSnacks.desc: ¼ cup crunchy roasted chickpeas. Fiber + plant protein, lightly spiced.

laineSnacks.name: Cucumber + Hummus
laineSnacks.desc: ½ cucumber sliced + ~4 tbsp hummus for dipping.

laineSnacks.name: Greek Yogurt + Berries
laineSnacks.desc: 1 Oikos Triple Zero + small handful thawed berries.

jakeSnacks.name: Tuna Straight from Can
jakeSnacks.desc: Drain and eat with a fork. Lime + a pinch of cumin.

jakeSnacks.name: Cottage Cheese + Banana
jakeSnacks.desc: ½ cup cottage cheese + 1 banana. Calcium + potassium.

jakeSnacks.name: Roasted Chickpeas + Almonds
jakeSnacks.desc: ¼ cup roasted chickpeas + a small handful of almonds.

jakeSnacks.name: Kefir (plain lowfat)
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 cup plain lowfat kefir. Strong calcium + B12 + probiotics.

Must Buy: Flank/sirloin steak — ~1.1 lbs (Mon bowls + Tue tacos)
Frozen shrimp — ~0.85 lbs (Tue tacos + Thu salad)
Canned tuna in water — 1.25 cans (Laine's 5 lunch jars)
Chicken breast — ~3.2 lbs (Jake's lunch batch only)
Black beans — 5–6 cans (used most nights + both lunches)
Cotija cheese — 1 container (~8oz, used most nights)
Limes — 6–8, or a bottle of lime juice
Corn tortillas (small) — 1–2 packs (Tue tacos + Sat side + Sun migas)
Romaine lettuce — 1–2 heads/hearts (Tue tacos + Thu salad + Laine lunch)
Check Supply: White rice — small amount needed (Mon, Wed)
Liquid egg whites — 1–2 cartons (breakfasts + Sun dinner)
Oikos Triple Zero — 6+ containers (Laine breakfasts + snacks)
Garlic — check you have a few cloves left
Cumin / paprika / garlic powder — restock the spice tin if low
Already Have: Olive oil — check bottle is at least half full

extras.name: Southwest Corn & Black Bean Salsa
extras.note: The warm salsa spooned over Wednesday's cod. Also good as a scoopable side on its own.
steps: Warm the corn, black beans, and diced tomatoes together in a small pan, 3–4 min.
Stir in lime juice, cumin, and salt off the heat.
